name: FITTERS
recent: FITTERS 计划出售其棕榈油子公司，将资金重新配置到核心业务。公司还面临一项重大诉讼，并已将财政年度结束日变更。最近一个季度的营收环比增长 53%，净利润为 519 万令吉。
notable: 计划出售棕榈油子公司，将资金重新配置到核心业务。
risks: 财政年度结束日变更可能影响财务报告可比性。
earnings: 最近一个季度（截至2026年8月31日）营收为9849.2万令吉，环比增长53%，净利润为519万令吉，净利润率5.3%，较上一季度的-3.1%转正。

recent_en: FITTERS plans to dispose of its palm oil subsidiary to redeploy funds into core businesses. The company also faces a material litigation and has changed its financial year end. Latest quarter revenue rose 53% QoQ with net income of MYR5.19 million.
notable_en: Plans to dispose of palm oil subsidiary to redeploy funds into core businesses.
risks_en: Change in financial year end may affect comparability of financial reporting.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 31 Aug 2026, revenue was MYR98.492 million, up 53% QoQ, with net income of MYR5.19 million and net margin of 5.3%, turning positive from -3.1% in the previous quarter.
